entries.text: See an update’s version and release details beside its actions in Settings, with a consistently sized update control in the Article Library footer.

When you ask the Assistant to work on selected text, it can use up to 500 characters of read-only text on either side for context. Before sending, the composer explains that this additional text is shared with your provider; only the selection can be replaced.

Edit proposed wording during review while keeping the original text unchanged. Decide changes individually or mark all accepted, mark all rejected, or reset decisions. Apply accepted changes to create a Revision; applying an all-rejected review closes it without changing the Article. Applying changes returns you to Write.
Proposal generation rejects body text that repeats the Article title as though it were part of the body.
See your message while the Assistant prepares your request.
New author guides explain built-in Skills for drafting, revising, fact checking, style review, terminology checks, and translation.
